raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 28 re-delivered rows with record_version=2 that share txn_id with an existing version-1 row, and silver_transactions keeps every copy that is POSTED, so those txn_ids are duplicated. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, which also means a superseding REVERSED version removes the transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
